name: Tamsin Reed
title: Captain of the Lanternguard
blurb: Solenne's toughest soldier, always the last one through the gate. She leads every evacuation of the war.

name: Brannoc Emberhand
title: Smith-Lord of the Reach
blurb: A giant smith who forged half the gates of Solenne, freed from the Saltmother's tide-cage still swearing. His forge-hammer never cools.

name: Kaela Stormrider
title: Marshal of the Steppe
blurb: First rider of the Galeborn, who had never ridden in the direction of retreat. Lightning lance, and a grey stallion called Thunderclap.

name: Sylvaine Thornwhisper
title: Warden-Archer of the Deep
blurb: Three hundred years old, she held Elderhollow alone for nine days. Her arrows grow where they land.

name: Mirelle the Tide-Seer
title: Seer of Frostmere
blurb: A blind young seer who reads the future in ice. She has seen a death at the end of the war, and will not say whose.

name: Gorrim Stonebeard
title: Shield of the Canyon
blurb: A Stoneborn shieldmaster with an iron ring in his beard for every friend he has buried. His shield is a carved stone door.

name: Corvin the Uncrowned
title: Ranger-King of the Rift
blurb: The Queen's exiled half-brother, framed for murder by the Regent. He knew the truth for six years and nobody listened.

name: Ignar
title: the Cinder Warden
blurb: The Warden of Fire, freed from the madness that made him the Cinder Tyrant. Black stone and a molten heart.

name: Aurath
title: of the Storms
blurb: The Warden of Storm, freed from the Thunderhead. A rider of cloud and lightning who is never quite still.

name: Elowen
title: the Evergreen
blurb: The Warden of Nature, freed from the Elder Broodmother. Very old, very tired, and still growing.

name: Thalassa
title: of the Deep
blurb: The Warden of Water, freed from the Tidal Leviathan. She remembers every ship and every child.

name: Orrok
title: the Mountain
blurb: The Warden of Earth, freed from the Mountain Titan. A slow stone giant with trees on his shoulders.

name: Nyxara
title: of the Hollow
blurb: The Warden of Void, who fought the Hollow King's crown from the inside. Keeper of the road of the dead.

name: Ilyra the Unbroken
title: Daughter of the Regent
blurb: The Regent's lost daughter, six years a captive of the dark. She bends the Outer Hollow, and she is the only one her father might stop for.

name: Seraphel the Dawnblade
title: Knight of the Sunstone
blurb: The last knight of the Sunstone, kept alive by its light for nine hundred years. It is broken, and she has one fight left.

name: Oswin the White Lantern
title: Master of the Order of the Spire
blurb: The Grey Lantern fell into the Crack at the start of the war. He walked the road of the dead the whole way round the world, and came back carrying every light the war put out.

name: Queen Ysolde
title: Queen of Solenne, the narrator
blurb: Ruler of the Concord. Blinded when the Sunstone broke, she rules by voice and tells the story.

name: Master Tobias Fennick
title: Chief Tower-Wright
blurb: The gruff old engineer who designed every tower. He held the Dawn Gate on the Night of Falling Stars.

name: Cassivane Dral
title: the Ashen Regent
blurb: Lord Marshal of the Concord, who opened the Crack to bring his daughter back from the dead.

name: Saltmother Ourra
title: the Drowned Herald
blurb: Once the Tidefolk's high priestess. Walks inside a column of black seawater. Boss of Cinder Steps.

name: Gorrath the Quarried
title: the Stone Herald
blurb: A Stoneborn general who carved out his own heart. Breaks into walking boulders. Boss of Galeback Ridge.

name: The Pale Vesper
title: the Hollow Herald
blurb: A Veilwalker singer who walked the dead to rest and now sings them awake. Boss of Rootway.

name: Ashwick the Kindled
title: the Flame Herald
blurb: The Concord's youngest messenger, an ever-burning boy who never stops running. Boss of Saltmarsh Bends.

name: Vholt Stormcrown
title: the Sky Herald
blurb: Kaela's old teacher, riding a thunderbird of black cloud. Boss of Canyon Switchbacks.

name: Mother Briar
title: the Thorn Herald
blurb: The Deepwood's wisest healer, grown through with thorns. Boss of Fractured Steps.
Revealed only in the post-credits scene. The villain of Part 2. Keep hidden from every codex and menu.

name: Vael-Orrun
title: the Sunderer
blurb: Once the good king who kept the peace between the seven kingdoms, betrayed and burned out by the other six. He turned to the Unmaking for justice and became a tyrant, and has come back to reclaim his crown and his throne.
